title: Emerging Hip hop artist LW6 shares new single "Snowin"
htmlContent:
LW6 is a talented rapper and songwriter who delivers his fans with an exhilarating sound that catches your attention once you hit the play button. Hailing from Ireland, LW6 is looking to take over the rap scene. LW6 comes together with TheKidOnfroy to bring a signature sound that leaves earth on the new song "Snowin."

LW6 "Snowin'" feat. TheKidOnfroy is a master class of musicianship where you hear the talent in, as all the many qualities of the music shine through to deliver something you must listen to. Although coming out of a recently thriving city in the world of hip hop, Lw6 has proven how hard-working he is in getting to his destination with his ever-growing fan base.
